description: Factory — Johnny's autonomous software-delivery control plane. Installs the knowledge any agent needs to work in Factory: what it is, where its infrastructure lives, how it builds, what it builds, and the rails — plus the units of work themselves (the 15 seed PBIs in pbis/, live facet snapshots for Linear/GitHub/Beads in units/ with the cross-facet map) and the contracts layer (per-domain Spec Contracts and the §0.1 typed-contract template in contracts/). Doctrine derives from factory-master-spec.md (the single canonical source of truth); live-state facts are marked LIVE-VERIFIED 2026-10-30, SPEC-ONLY, or GAP, and facet exports are SNAPSHOT 2026-10-30 — re-pull via the named routes before trusting them as current.

factory.note: The ONE Factory control plane: Port's MCP gateway (ADR-001, master spec §18.5 Single-MCP). Auth is Port-issued (External Interface OAuth app 'Factory', ADR-005; machine credentials for unattended runs). This plugin points at the gateway — it never re-implements it, and no credential is bundled in this package. US region host, if your tenant is US: https://mcp.us.port.io/v1.

name: factory
